name: Gulf commercial advertising
note: Starter suite. Prompts describe generic scenes only: no brand, no named real person, no claim about a specific property. Extend to 20+ prompts with the client-facing team before using results for a decision.
negative: morphing, warped geometry, distorted faces or hands, flicker, on-screen text, watermark, cartoon look

prompts.prompt: Low-angle tracking shot of a white luxury SUV driving along a wet coastal boulevard at night in a modern Gulf city, glass towers and palm trees lit warm gold, reflections on the asphalt, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens, premium automotive commercial.

Extreme close-up of an amber glass perfume bottle on black marble, slow dolly-in, a wisp of incense smoke crossing a single shaft of warm light, gold cap catching a rim light, luxury fragrance advertisement, 85mm lens.
Slow-motion close-up of Arabic coffee poured from a brass dallah into a small handleless cup, steam rising, dates on a wooden tray, warm window light, shallow depth of field, hospitality commercial.

Medium shot of a Gulf family gathered in a contemporary majlis with low cushioned seating, a man in a white thobe and red-checked shemagh hands a tablet to his young son, warm practical lamps, gentle dolly-in, telecom advertisement.

Tracking shot following a woman in an elegant black abaya walking through a bright modern shopping mall carrying shopping bags, polished floor reflections, soft daylight from a glass roof, fashion retail commercial.
Handheld cinematic shot of a delivery rider handing a paper bag to a customer at the door of a modern villa at dusk, warm porch light, natural smiles, food delivery app advertisement.

Slow crane-up from a businessman in a thobe looking at his phone on a rooftop terrace to reveal a financial district skyline at blue hour, clean negative space on the right for a logo, corporate banking film.
Top-down slow push-in on an iftar table at sunset, lanterns glowing, hands reaching for dates and water glasses, warm golden light, rich textures, Ramadan campaign.
